overlays.toast.unlockSpeed3: 3× speed unlocked! Press 3 to use it.
overlays.toast.dayEnd: Daily Ledger, day {day}: earned {earned}, wages {wages}, {released} released
overlays.toast.unpaid: Wages of {wages} not fully paid. Staff dawdle for a day.
overlays.toast.parcel: New land bought! More room to build.
overlays.closeBody: Closes the window. The game continues as before.
overlays.sfxBody: Volume of clicks, stamps and coins, now {n}%.
overlays.ambienceBody: Volume of waves, gulls and chatter, now {n}%.
overlays.muteOnBody: All sound is off. Switch it back on here.
overlays.muteOffBody: Turns off music, effects and ambience at once.
overlays.shakeOnBody: The screen wobbles a little in funny moments. Switch it off here.
overlays.shakeOffBody: The screen stays still. Switch it on for wobbly fun moments.
overlays.resetBody: Deletes your saved lockup and starts again on day 1. Asks once more first.
overlays.resetYesBody: Deletes the save and reloads the game. This cannot be undone.
overlays.credits.made: Art and code were made for this game.
overlays.credits.sounds: Sounds: Kenney, rubberduck, TinyWorlds, jasinski, Rango Mango and other OpenGameArt contributors (CC0).
overlays.credits.whistle: Whistle sound: “Whistles” by dklon (opengameart.org/content/whistles), CC BY 3.0, levelled for this game.

overlays.credits.thanks: Thanks for keeping the rascals cosy!
overlays.help.click: Select a room or rascal; use the ferry horn, gate stamp and crates
overlays.help.dragBuild: With a build tool: outline the new room
overlays.help.edge: Selected room: make it bigger, you only pay the difference
overlays.help.dbl: Centre the camera on a room
overlays.help.undo: Undo the last build (until 10 s after it is done, full refund)
overlays.help.shift: Hold while placing: keep the build tool
overlays.help.esc: Cancel the tool, close a panel or window
overlays.help.tap: Select; use the horn, stamp and crates
overlays.help.oneFinger: Pan the camera; with a build tool: outline the room
overlays.help.confirm: Buy or drop the outlined room
overlays.reason.noRoom: Needs a finished room of the right type first
overlays.reason.noFerry: No ferry is arriving right now
overlays.reason.open: Pay back the current loan first
